tool_arguments.prompt: Create ONE single full-body bird prop drawing, on a truly transparent background. Freshly redraw the attached adopted ORIGINAL as nearly identical in anatomy, proportions, framing and standing pose as possible, changing ONLY the brown dot eye to a small gently CLOSED brown eyelid curve. This is a quiet blink, not a nod, stretch, alert pose or head raise. CRITICAL: keep the head, bill and crest at the SAME relative height above its body and feet as original; exact compact neck LENGTH and head WIDTH/HEIGHT, same shoulder-to-neck gap, same rounded torso LENGTH/WIDTH and belly volume, same short feet position and foot support. Do not elongate neck, lift the whole head, enlarge crest, lengthen forehead feathers or alter the body/feet to make it look similar. Match all the original markings/palette, warm brown outline weight and original paper-grain watercolor texture. Retain original plain-eye style as a short CLOSED curve; no white eye surround or sparkle, no human face/mouth/hands. Keep bill/crest/wing/tail tips intact, body comfortably inside transparent margin, same original facing with wings folded exactly as in original, feet planted. No background/ground/shadow haze, symbols, text, extra props, duplicate parts or extra feather shards. SINGLE drawing at large native resolution, not a sheet or comparison. The attached original is the identity/style reference, not a pixel-edit target.
